title: Frontiers: Recommending What to Search: Sales Volume and Consumption Diversity Effects of a Query Recommender System
authors: Shuang Zheng; Siliang Tong; Hyeokkoo Eric Kwon; Gordon Burtch; Xianneng Li
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment (query recommender system on/off). Tables 2-3 are cross-sectional OLS of user-level tap, order and query volumes on a treatment dummy with demographic controls (robust SE). No panel, no DiD; data are a perturbed 10,000-user sample.
design_notes: QRS_replication_code.do: reg <outcome> treatment Age Gender Education Marriage_Status Spending_Level Membership_Tier, r (levels and logs); Table 1 balance t-tests.
data_files_note: Random sample of 10,000 users with values perturbed for NDA compliance.
data_provenance_note: Readme: 'derived from the original dataset ... through a random sampling of 10,000 users, followed by perturbations of the original values to comply with the NDA requirements.'
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
